name: Dual Constraint Equivalence Network
description: Replaces the linear algebra "difference vector spanning" framing with its dual: a system of equality constraints x_u = x_v. By framing the spanning condition as logical necessity of equalities and explicitly describing the network as a connected set of m=n-1 links, it preserves the tree property perfectly without using the word "tree" or vector subspaces. This defeats solvers that pattern-match on "difference vector" or "subspace spanning" to instantly trigger tree algorithms, forcing them to genuinely recognize that m=n-1 connected links forms a unique-path topology.
